# AGENTS.md - docker-sonarr

For AI coding agents and the humans driving them. Read it fully before changing anything. When this file
and your instincts disagree, this file wins. When it is silent, copy what the surrounding code does.

## Purpose

This repository builds the `sonarr` container image, published as
`ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/sonarr`. It is one of many LinuxServer.io images built from one shared pipeline, so a
change that looks like an improvement in isolation is often wrong here.

## Decide where the change belongs

1. A bug or feature in the application itself: upstream, not here.
2. Only matters to one user or one setup: a custom script in `/custom-cont-init.d` or `/custom-services.d`.
3. Useful to a subset of users (extra package, driver, plugin, integration, sidecar): a
   [Docker Mod](https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-mods), not this repo.
4. Most users benefit, or the image is broken: a pull request here.

## Layout and what you may edit

| Path | Edit? | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.aarch64` | yes | One per architecture. Any change goes in both. |
| `root/` | yes | Copied to `/`. s6-overlay v3 units under `root/etc/s6-overlay/s6-rc.d/`. |
| `image.yml` | yes | The manifest. Source of truth for README, docs, stores, proxy confs, build and test settings. Schema: `https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/builder/blob/main/schemas/image.schema.json` |
| `package_versions.txt` | no | Written by the build on the live branch. |
| `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `LICENSE` | no | Generated from `image.yml`. |
| `.github/workflows/build.yml` | no | Generated; calls the shared workflow `linuxserver-playground/workflows`. |

Do not add top-level files or tooling: no compose files, Makefiles, linters, extra workflows, CHANGELOG.md.
Live branches: master, develop. Each has its own `image.yml`; target the branch the change applies to.

## Style

- Dockerfile: single `RUN` chain joined with `&& \`, steps announced with `echo "**** doing thing ****"`,
  two-space indent, packages one per line alphabetically, build deps in a virtual package or purged in the
  same layer, cleanup step last. Never pin the application version: CI passes `SONARR_VERSION`.
- No `HEALTHCHECK`, `USER`, `ENTRYPOINT`, `CMD`. Do not touch the `LABEL` lines.
- s6 scripts start with `#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash` and `# shellcheck shell=bash`, four-space indent,
  `[[ ]]`, `"${VAR}"`, `lsiown` not `chown`, `s6-setuidgid abc`, `exec` the final process. Keep `run`
  files executable. Guard privileged operations when `runtime.readonly` or `runtime.nonroot` is supported.
- Config lives in `/config`; copy defaults only if absent; migrations go in `root/migrations/`.
- New environment variables are a last resort.

## Documentation and changelog

- User-facing text lives in `image.yml` (`summary`, `docs.setup`, `runtime.*` descriptions).
- Any change under `Dockerfile*` or `root/` adds an entry at the top of `changelog:` as
  `- { date: YYYY-MM-DD, text: Short factual sentence. }`.

## Validate locally

```bash
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/repo ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/builder:latest check     # manifest + generated files
docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/repo ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/builder:latest render    # regenerate README/AGENTS (live branch only)
docker build --no-cache --pull -t sonarr:test .
docker run --rm -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -v "$PWD/testconfig:/config" -p 8989:8989 sonarr:test
```

Confirm `[ls.io-init] done.` appears, the app starts, and it survives a restart against an existing
`/config`. If you cannot run Docker, say so; never claim testing that did not happen.

## Pull requests

- Disclose AI use in the description: which tool, for what.
- One focused change per PR, smallest diff, no drive-by refactors or wording-only changes.
- Commit subjects are short imperative sentences, no prefixes, no emoji, no trailers.
- The PR build publishes to `ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/untrusted-pr/sonarr:pr-<n>-<sha>` for reviewers only.
- Builds of this PR fail if `README.md` or `AGENTS.md` were hand-edited or if `image.yml` does not validate.
